LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_ChooseParticipants: Select the host and ritual target manually. Hover over portraits for eligibility; assigning a role checks again.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_MissingRoles: Select a host and ritual target first.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_Invalid: The selected pawn cannot fill this ritual role right now.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_Candidate: Basic role requirements are met; choose a counterpart to check the pair.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_PairReady: Current pair requirements are met; reachability and body requirements still need checking.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_Allowed: Can currently be assigned to this role.
LanguageData.SSC_RitualSelection_Legend: Badges show basic role eligibility. Hover over portraits for conditions; a slash marks an unavailable role, and a check marks an assigned role.
